title: Nine Acres of Grass
subtitle: 校园与学校 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 校园与学校（生活与学习·学校与校园）
meta: 主题语境：校园与学校（生活与学习·学校与校园）　|　核心词汇：campus　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 campus 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 my mother was sent to map ① a campus she could not enter, and she said the entering was the whole of the lesson. The ② campus, meaning the grounds and not the college, was nine acres and was walked by whoever came last; a campus, she said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ campus in that town had the same gate, and the ④ campus at the north, meaning the one the warden kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever mapped properly. A campus, my grandmother said, is nine parts grass and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the grass is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ campus was the whole of the college, meaning the college it held and not the grounds. The ⑥ campus, meaning the college and not any of that, is the only thing in a city that everybody crosses and nobody questions; a campus, he said, is either something you map or the only word that means both grounds and a college. She said the college is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ campus had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the gate. The ⑧ campus of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine acres and eleven years of walking; a campus, she said, is either the one at the north or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ campus I remember is the one at the north, which was planted in 1983 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ campus, my grandmother said in 1988, is the only thing that improves by being crossed; every campus, she said, is a college that has agreed to look like grounds. She said the college was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 校园（指那片场地本身，与学院相对）
C. 固定搭配：map a campus 测绘一个校园
D. n. 校园（指镇上每一处）
E. n. 校园（指北面那一处）
F. n. 校园（抽象：它容纳的那所学院）
G. n. 那所学院（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a campus she could not enter
The campus, meaning the grounds and not the college
campus was the whole of the college
the campus had become a photograph in a report
The campus of the whole thing
A campus, my grandmother said in 1988

answers.why: map a campus 意为“测绘一个校园”，1960 年母亲被派去测绘一个她进不去的校园。
campus 意为“校园”，指那片场地本身而不是学院，共九英亩，由最后走的人走遍。
campus 指镇上每一处校园，每一处都是同样的大门。
campus 指北面那一处（学监管的一处），是唯一有人认真测绘过的。
campus 意为“校园”，抽象指它容纳的那所学院，父亲说 campus 就是那所学院的全部。
campus 为抽象用法，指那所学院本身，是城市里人人都穿行、却没人质疑的东西。
campus 意为“校园、校区”，到 1978 年这处 campus 成了报告里的一张照片。
campus 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英亩和十一年的行走。
campus 意为“校园”，我记得的是北面那一处，1983 年种上草，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
campus 为抽象总称，祖母说校园是唯一会因为有人穿行而变好的地方。
